update public.customers set price_list_id = null where company_id = p_company and id = p_customer

insert into public.customer_price_lists(company_id, customer_id, price_list_id, updated_by)
  values (p_company, p_customer, p_list, auth.uid())
  on conflict (company_id, customer_id) do update set price_list_id = excluded.price_list_id,
    updated_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_by = auth.uid()
update public.customers set price_list_id = p_list where company_id = p_company and id = p_customer

sql_tablas_nuevas: alter table public.empresas_numeradores enable row level security;

alter table public.ventas_clientes add constraint ventas_clientes_lista_precio_fkey foreign key (empresa_id, lista_precio_id) references public.ventas_listas_precios(empresa_id, id);
sql_permisos_nuevos: revoke all on table public.empresas_numeradores from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
sql_final: drop event trigger if exists ensure_rls;
create event trigger ensure_rls on ddl_command_end when tag in ('CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO') execute function public.rls_auto_enable();
